basis: Accepted second-pass mathematical reports and separate independent audit. Numerical outcomes are bounded checks; arbitrary-size conclusions rest on the complete proofs.

physical_board_family.all_24_state_thin_cases: Singletons and 1 by 2, 2 by 1, 1 by 7, 7 by 1 boards; generated correct labels and a terminal-label corruption on each nonsingleton.
physical_board_family.fixed_seed_arbitrary_rectangles: 70 labelings for each of 2 by 3, 3 by 3 and 3 by 4; all four top-compatible initial states; seed 20261013.
physical_board_family.limit: The aggregate describes the accepted check. Exact randomly generated board arrays are not reproduced and the published aggregate is not a standalone replay of every prior test input.

independent_audit.multigraph_family: All connected multigraphs on 2, 3 or 4 named vertices, with loops and repeated edges, having from n−1 through 6 edges; terminals 0 and n−1.
independent_audit.ribbon_field_family: All 24 orientations on widths 2, 4, 6, 10, 16 and heights 3, 7, 11, 15, plus 40 by 43.
independent_audit.collar_family: 24 orientations, four directions, two sides and sixteen independent sign choices on four collar cells.
independent_audit.polygon_convention: Every directed simple unit-grid polygon rooted at the origin is counted, retaining starting direction and traversal direction. Full-state-closed counts are 0, 0, 16, 40 at lengths 4, 6, 8, 10 respectively.

known_source_regression.attribution: Marzio De Biasi, Rolling a Cube can be Tricky, May 2012 Version 0.03, Figure 4
known_source_regression.independent_confirmation: The separate audit independently replayed both known witnesses and enumerated every one of the 92,378 ten-edge optional subsets; the same three local completions and two connected paths were obtained.
known_source_regression.limit: These are two prior-literature witnesses in one shared conditioned branch, not a new nonuniqueness construction or a count over other branches. Source board labels, routes and orientation tables are not reproduced.

certificate_assembly.purpose: Editorial exact data for independently inspecting already accepted examples and semantics; not a new research pass.
objects: 4 by 3 ribbon, all 17 adjacencies, both traversal directions and four initial states
authored 2 by 5 cap and its endpoint-migrated traversal
3 by 3 ring, four center arrivals and all 24 center states
eastward four-cell rail, all sixteen collar sign assignments
eight affine candidates of an abstract loop/parallel multigraph
five abstract records representing six port, state, loop and connectedness checks
certificate_assembly.validation: The certificate was recomputed and checked against independent integer-vector rotations, physical route replay and direct subset/degree checks. See CERTIFICATE_GUIDE.md for program-independent instructions.

limits: No general polynomial bound on surviving cycle rank k is proved.
No surviving ambiguous-state rectangle is asserted.
Abstract semantic kernels are not asserted to be realizable die boards.
Full-state compatibility is not replaced by phase projection.
No source text or source dataset contents are included.
General graph contraction and cycle-space methods are not claimed as new.
